_comment: Known-flake signatures for the optimistic trunk merge-coordinator (ADR-0055). Each entry matches a FAILED CI job by its job-name pattern (`shardPattern`, an extended-regex matched against the GitHub job `name`) AND a `logPattern` (extended-regex matched against that job's downloaded log text). A failed job that matches BOTH is bucketed as a KNOWN FLAKE: the coordinator treats it as NON-BLOCKING and merges THROUGH it WITHOUT a rerun (the core throughput win — see ADR-0055 'Land-fast gate'). A failed job that matches NO signature is a REAL failure (real-gate or affected-shard) and blocks/escalates. Keep this list TIGHT: an over-broad logPattern that swallows a genuine regression silently lands red trunk. `label` is the flake-rate bucket key surfaced by the dashboard so we know which flake to fix first (expected: deadlock-40P01 dominates). Extensible — add a new {shardPattern, logPattern, label} object to quarantine a newly-confirmed flake; remove one to stop merging through a flake that has been fixed. The coordinator NEVER auto-quarantines: every entry here is a deliberate, human-reviewed decision. shardPattern is anchored against the FULL job name including the 'Server Tests (<shard>)' wrapper.

signatures.label: deadlock-40P01
signatures._comment: Postgres '40P01: deadlock detected' under concurrent shard execution. honua-server#1568 / [Collection("Database")]. The #1-frequency flake and the entire reason for merge-through. Scoped to the shards that share the Database collection under contention; NOT a blanket match.

signatures.label: ryuk-image-pull
signatures.logPattern: ryuk|testcontainers\.org/ryuk|failed to pull image|manifest unknown|toomanyrequests|TaskCanceledException.*pull|net/http: TLS handshake timeout|i/o timeout.*registry
signatures._comment: Testcontainers Ryuk reaper / Docker registry image-pull transient failures (rate limits, TLS/i-o timeouts). Infra flake, not a code regression.

signatures.label: docker-unavailable
signatures.logPattern: DockerUnavailableException|Cannot connect to the Docker daemon|docker daemon is not running|Docker.DotNet.*DockerApiException.*connection
signatures._comment: DockerUnavailableException on Database-collection tests when the runner has no Docker — hits auth/STAC Foundation jobs. Environmental, not code.
